ABSORB_LIFE.title: Absorb Life
BACKLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Transfer {IfUpgraded:show:all debuffs|one random debuff} on you to the enemy.
BACKLASH.title: Backlash
BORROWED_TIME_OLD.title: Borrowed Time (Old)
CONDENSE.description: [gold]Transform[/gold] any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soul+|Soul}[/gold].
CONDENSE.title: Condense
DEATHMATCH.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
At the start of next turn, [gold]Osty[/gold] dies.
DEATHMATCH.title: Deathmatch
DESPERATE_GUARD.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Osty[/gold] absorbs all HP you are about to lose.
DESPERATE_GUARD.title: Desperate Guard
FLAME_OF_SOULS.title: Flame of Souls
FRIENDS_FROM_BEYOND.description:
Add a [gold]Soul[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Whenever you play a [gold]Soul[/gold], gain [blue]{FriendsFromBeyondPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
FRIENDS_FROM_BEYOND.title: Friends from Beyond
FUNERAL.description:
Whenever a card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] due to [gold]Ethereal[/gold],
 gain {FuneralPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
FUNERAL.title: Funeral
GET_READY.title: Get Ready
GNAW.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Summon[/gold] amount equal to damage dealt.
GNAW.title: Gnaw
GROW_WILD.title: Grow Wild
HOVERING.description: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], Add {HoveringPower:diff()} [gold]{HoveringPower:plural:Soul|Souls}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
HOVERING.title: Hovering
JOIN_HANDS.description:
At the start of the next combat, [gold]Summon[/gold] [gold]Osty[/gold] with HP equal to his HP at the end of this combat.
([gold]Summon[/gold] 25 at most)
JOIN_HANDS.title: Join Hands
MUSCLE_MEMORY.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
When you play an [gold]Osty[/gold] Attack for the first time each turn, add its damage to this card.
MUSCLE_MEMORY.title: Muscle Memory
NECROPHAGY.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
If this kills an enemy, [gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
NECROPHAGY.title: Necrophagy
OVERDRAW.description: Shuffle any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} if at least {Cards:diff()} cards are shuffled.
OVERDRAW.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose cards to shuffle into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
OVERDRAW.title: Overdraw
PROVOKE.description: In this turn, increase the amount each time you [gold]Summon[/gold] by {ThrivePower:diff()}, and [gold]Osty's[/gold] attacks deal {CalcifyPower:diff()} additional damage.
PROVOKE.title: Provoke
REMEMBRANCE.description: Put an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show: It's free to play this turn.}
REMEMBRANCE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to put back in your Hand.
REMEMBRANCE.title: Remembrance
SPLICE.title: Splice
THRIVE.description: Increase the amount each time you [gold]Summon[/gold] by {ThrivePower:diff()}.
THRIVE.title: Thrive
TREMOR.title: Tremor
